ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) grayscale values across the primary fluke surface with high-intensity (white) linear striations providing a high macro-level contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive mapping of high-contrast white linear 'blobs' or rake marks. Left lobe: multiple parallel diagonal and zigzag patterns. Right lobe: vertical and curved parallel clusters of white pixels against the dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35-40 degrees; depth relative to lobe height is approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge boundary featuring low-frequency serrations; a distinct high-amplitude notch is visible on the inner-left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex curvature along the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering to sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized circular high-intensity pixel clusters visible near the distal tips and along the superior edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned and parallel white linear disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 60% of the visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring likely resulting from inter-species interaction; visible notch/trauma site on the mid-left trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-intensity zigzag marking located on the upper-left quadrant of the left fluke lobe.
